div.div: This diagram has been done as a component of the White paper titled "Suggested Measures for Deploying IIIF in Swiss cultural heritage institutions" in the context of the Towards IIIF-Compliance Knowledge in Switzerland (TICKS) project conducted by Julien A. Raemy and René Schneider at the Haute école de gestion de Genève, which is part of the HES-SO University of Applied Sciences and Arts Western Switzerland.

div.style: display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); line-height: 1.2; vertical-align: top; width: 206px; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal; text-align: center;

span.font: Great that your IIIF Manifests are valid. Bear in mind that version 3 of the Image and Presentation APIs will soon become the norm. You may need to convert them to the latest specifications at some point.

div.div: RAEMY, Julien A. SCHNEIDER, René. IIIF Step-by-Step. Version 1.1. March 2019
